name: Kruithof: warm light at low lux, cool light at high lux

direction.note: Use the curve only to keep a candle-warm scene dim and a daylight-cool scene bright.

claim: Kruithof's 1941 graph says that warm light looks pleasant at low illuminance and cool light at high illuminance, but a review of later experiments does not support the graph.
caveat: Treat this as a weak heuristic: the 1941 data are thin, and the review finds only that very low illuminance is unpleasant, with no preferred colour temperature.

sources.title: Fotios 2017, A revised Kruithof graph based on empirical data, LEUKOS 13(1)
